🎬 Landman (2024–Present) — Drama, Western

Tommy Norris works as a landman in the oil industry of West Texas, where his job is to manage deals, solve problems, and keep powerful people satisfied in a business where money and danger often go hand in hand. After being drawn deeper into the oil world, Tommy finds himself surrounded by ambitious executives, roughneck workers, criminals, and people willing to take serious risks for wealth.

As Tommy tries to keep the oil operation running, problems begin piling up both professionally and personally. Every decision can affect millions of dollars, while dangerous situations force him to navigate a world where loyalty can change quickly and mistakes can have serious consequences.

The series explores ambition, family, wealth, power, responsibility, and the complicated relationship between success and risk. Tommy's story shows that behind the massive oil industry are ordinary people making difficult choices in an environment where business, personal relationships, and danger constantly collide.

More than just a drama about the oil industry, Landman is a story about power, survival, and the price people are willing to pay for success in a world driven by money and ambition. 🔥

💬 Do you think the money and power of the oil business are worth the risks that come with it? 👇
